faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I need friends to use ShowSync?
faq.a1: No! ShowSync works great for solo viewers too. Rate shows you've watched and get personalized recommendations just for you. Create watch rooms only when you want to watch with friends.
faq.q2: How does the AI know what I like?
faq.a2: You rate shows you've watched (love, like, or dislike). Our AI analyzes your taste profile and finds shows that match your preferences - not just what's trending.
faq.a3: Yes! ShowSync is completely free forever. No hidden fees, no credit card required, no premium tiers. Just great recommendations.
faq.a4: About 2 minutes. Sign up, rate 5-10 shows you've watched, and you're ready to get recommendations. The more you rate, the better the suggestions.
